newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Diamond Shamrock seen up.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Diamond Shamrock seen up.

text.p: Share in Diamond Shamrock Inc are expected to firm at Monday's U.S market open on news the company agreed to a merger-of-equals with Ultramar Corp, traders said.
Preceding the opening, the shares were quoted in line-with Friday's close, but traders said they expect interest in the shares to increase.
They reported no activity in Ultramar stock.
Ultramar and Diamond Shamrock said terms of the merger call for conversion of each Diamond Shamrock share into 1.02 shares of Ultramar.
Ultramar shares closed on Friday at 28-1/2 while Diamond Shamrock shares closed at 30-1/4.
Under the established ratio, Diamond Shamrock shares are valued at just over $29 each.
Based on Diamond Shamrock's 29.3 million common shares, the value is about $850 million.
Traders said they expect Mossimo Inc shares to fall at the open after the company warned of an a third quarter earnings shortfall, though sales are expected to rise.
Also, Merrill Lynch lowered the stock to a near-term neutral from accumulate, and kept it a long-term buy.
